resolution.note: krn verify tickets step refuses foreign Ticket trailers; slice run passes --task

title: krn verify refuses a PR commit whose Ticket trailer differs from the PR task
body:
Outcome: krn verify fails before review when any PR commit carries a Ticket trailer other than the task the PR delivers, naming the commit. In #224 a tracker commit adding t-ta1cyc0 carried Ticket: t-ta1cyc0; verify and review 1 passed, deliver --dry-run exited 73 "PR commits require exactly one matching Ticket trailer", and the reword cost a second review attempt.
Proof: an observer runs krn verify on a branch whose tracker commit has a different Ticket trailer and asserts a non-zero exit naming the commit; the same branch with matching trailers passes.
